title: Tohoku University
description: Moments from my study-abroad days at Tohoku University

images.description: April 27, 2022 — my first visit to the lab, just a few days after arriving in Japan. Rolling green mountains outside the window; everything felt like a brand-new beginning.
May 26, 2022 — Aobayama Commons on the Aobayama New Campus. A cozy study space beneath the wooden lattice ceiling; it finally felt like university life had begun.

images.alt: A city in the mist, seen from the lab
images.description: June 7, 2022 — looking out from the lab, the city of Sendai drifted in and out of the rain mist. It truly felt like living in a misty forest.

images.alt: Walking through campus in dense fog
images.description: Late night, June 23, 2022 — walking through campus in dense fog. The glow of streetlights spread softly through the mist, and the path seemed to lead somewhere unknown.

Late night, June 23, 2022 — thick fog swallowed the whole grove, silhouettes of pine trees standing in the mist, the lights of the research building blurring into white. Hard to believe this was my own campus.
June 26, 2022 — my lab. Blue sky and summer clouds over the green mountains outside the window; so refreshing.
June 29, 2022 — under a brilliant crimson sunset, studying at the lab with a reference book in hand.

images.alt: A hidden classroom late at night
images.description: Late night, June 29, 2022 — an empty classroom. Sendai's city lights and distant mountains outside the window; a pandemic-era sticker still on the desk.

images.alt: A bright summer day at Kawauchi Campus
images.description: June 30, 2022 — a bright summer day at Kawauchi Campus. Green trees under a blue sky; the campus paths felt wonderfully fresh.
June 30, 2022 — cool and comfortable in the air-conditioned lab, with a sweeping view of lush summer mountains.
July 31, 2022 — Aobayama Commons in summer. Building and greenery in harmony under the blue sky.

images.alt: Dense forest stretching west from the lab
images.description: August 14, 2022 — looking west from the lab, a world of dense forest. No wonder they call Sendai the City of Trees.
August 22, 2022 — inside the lab. Desks, lamps, a sofa and a coffee pot; everyday life full of little comforts. I often took naps on that sofa.

images.alt: Cumulus clouds and shadows on a summer campus
images.description: August 28, 2022 — the campus just after the rain. Low cumulus clouds, and light and shadow crossing on the wet path in front of the brick lecture building.
Late night, August 31, 2022 — the bicycle parking lot in heavy fog. Rows of streetlights glowing pale blue through the mist.

images.alt: Campus in autumn, seen from the lab
images.description: November 15, 2022 — the campus after autumn arrived. The mountains dyed in autumn colors; the season deepening.

images.alt: A stunning autumn sunset in the west
images.description: November 15, 2022 — a sky grading from pink to violet, the ridgeline of the Ou Mountains in the distance. It felt less like a university lab and more like a quiet resort.

images.alt: Shuttle bus stop in a late-autumn grove
images.description: November 29, 2022 — the shuttle bus stop in a lonely late-autumn grove. The trees had shed their leaves; under a gray sky, the bus stop stood all alone by the road.
December 13, 2022 — soft winter sunlight. Golden light falling on the deck and glass railing on the 2nd floor of the Graduate School of Science building.

images.alt: A snow-country world at Kawauchi Campus
images.description: January 26, 2023 — a snow-country world at Kawauchi Campus. The campus at dusk wrapped in snow.
January 26, 2023 — taking a break here midway through grading linear algebra reports as a TA. The snow-covered bench and warm streetlight gave me a moment of winter peace.
